label: Troubleshooting Mode
description: Temporarily disables Tamper Protection and Real-Time Monitoring for troubleshooting

label: Reregister / Company Portal Issues
description: Forces device re-registration with Entra ID — resolves most Company Portal and compliance issues

label: Top 5 Memory-Hogging Processes
description: Identifies the five processes consuming the most RAM
code: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 Name, @{Name="RAM (MB)"; Expression={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet / 1MB, 2)}}
